# PR #3456: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #3439

All three red jobs of [super run 42488997384](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42488997384) on `staging` are fixed, following the plan in #3439. The component job passes as a whole only once a person shards it in `.github/`; the lines are at the end.

## What was wrong and what changed

**fuzz (3/4): the handicapped game of seed 6091 never ended** ("the resolution loop did not settle in 24000 passes").
- **Cause:** a crafted Trap (Meditative #17) with the "when your opponent attacks" reveal hat also fired on *forced* attacks, which R121 rules out.
- **The loop:**
  - The trap summoned a Sheep.
  - Warp Disruptor II (S #24) forced an attack on the Sheep.
  - The trap is Animated, so it re-armed and fired again, without end.
- **Fix:** `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs`, `reveal_trigger`: the attack case now ignores forced attacks, as the printed attack-reveal traps already do (Core #96 My Pawn, Explosive Runes, Doom Shroom, Predictive Shield).
- **Rulings:** R121 already decides this, so there is no new ruling.
  - `R0883.md` now says the reveal fires "never on a forced one, [[R121]]".
  - `R0121.md` lists `c017_true_craft_a_card.rs` in `proven_in`.
- **Tests:** two in `c017_true_craft_a_card.rs`:
  - `r121_r883_…_does_not_arm_on_a_forced_attack`: the trap stays set when Warp Disruptor II forces Moths to attack. It fails on the old `craft.rs` with "a forced attack is not the opponent declaring one (R121)".
  - `r121_r883_…_still_fires_on_a_declared_one`: the same trap still fires when p2 declares an attack itself.

**e2e (8/8): spec 38's "/practice board (phone)" ran axe while the opening deal was still running.**
- **Cause:** during the deal (#3366) the hand flies over the deck pile. axe measured the pile, so the listed `.pile--browsable` exception no longer fired.
- **Fix:** spec 38 now waits for `[data-dealing]` to clear before `cy.settled()`, on both boards (`dealt()`, and `DEALING` in `e2e/support/testids.ts`).
- The deal starts with the game's first view (`Game.tsx`), before the mulligan prompt appears, so the wait cannot pass too early.

**e2e component (chrome): cancelled at its 20-minute limit.** The suite takes about 31 minutes, and 8 specs were also failing.
- **Sharding:** `node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --component <k> <K>` splits `cypress/component/*.cy.tsx` by measured seconds (`COMPONENT_WEIGHTS`).
  - With K = 4, each shard is about 478 s.
  - All 62 specs land in exactly one shard.
  - The existing `8 8` output is byte-identical to before.
- **`default-looks` and `fx-signature`** ("ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications"):
  - Cause: `useFitText` in `apps/web/src/cards/fit.ts` refit text inside its own ResizeObserver callback. An Extended-art rules box grows with its text (R3343001), which re-triggered the observer.
  - Fix: that refit now runs in the next animation frame, at most one per box, and is cancelled on unmount. First fits and font-load refits are unchanged.
  - A new test in `fit.test.tsx` fails on the old code (9.86 px written inside the callback).
- **`landing-and-code-field`:** in landscape the footer was auto-placed beside the board. #3380's longer links widened it, which narrowed the board and wrapped the terms onto a third line. The footer now takes its own row (`tavern.css`).
- **`deckbuilder-layout`, phone:** #3380's "Back to decks" squeezed onto three lines, pushing the first pool row off screen. It now stays on one line (`workshop.css`).
- **`deckbuilder-layout`, #85:** the keyword check now skips cards whose Default look is full art. A Mythic's Default is Full art, with no rules box, while the Full-art setting is on (R3343001).
- **`card-versions`, part 5:** #3369 added a tenth face, which wrapped the row. The screenshot now uses `PART_FIVE_SHOT_WIDTH = 100`, as part 6 already does.
- **`fx-gallery-captures`:** the launch countdown is gone (R3334001; `starship.ts` builds it with no counts). The spec now checks for the flame and for no countdown.
- **`tile-aura`:**
  - Core #93 and #98 now wear auras of their own (R3400000). The fixture uses Frostspatula instead, and Paragon-X as a Mythic Flying Unit in the backrow (R1081000).
  - The aura sits inside the zone's border, so the spec now measures against the area inside it. The tolerance stays at 2.
- **`fx-phone-frame`:** `main`'s #3442 fixed this one while I worked (see below).

**Patch fragment:** `crates/cards/patches/pending/daily-super-run-failed-a-crafted-trap-that-reveals-on-an.json`, written with `cargo jackioh patches … --visual`, since `fit.ts` is under `apps/web/src/cards/`. Its player note: "A crafted Trap that reveals when your opponent attacks no longer reveals on an attack another card forces."

## How each job was checked

The early run was cut off by a usage limit, and the branch then had `main` (b170423) merged in. I redid every check below after the merge unless a line says otherwise.

| What | Command or method | Result |
|---|---|---|
| fuzz (3/4), seed 6091 | `jackioh fuzz --from 6091 --seeds 1 --handicap` | 1 passed. Before the merge, the base binary panicked "did not settle in 24000 passes" |
| fuzz (3/4), plain wave | `fuzz --from 5001 --seeds 2500` | 2500 passed, 0 failed |
| fuzz (3/4), handicapped wave | `fuzz --from 5001 --seeds 2500 --handicap` | 2500 passed, 0 failed |
| fuzz (3/4), Duos wave | `fuzz --duos --from 1001 --seeds 500` | 0 failed |
| CI's fuzz gate | `fuzz --seeds 200` | 200 passed |
| Golden replay | `golden check` | hotseat fixture folds to 512357ea |
| e2e (8/8) | spec 38 against a release `jackioh-server` (E2E=1) and a dev-mode client build, Chrome | 49 of 49 pass. Before the merge, the old spec file failed exactly as CI did ("/practice board (phone) … target-size .pile--browsable") |
| e2e component | the 8 specs, Chrome, quiet machine | tile-aura 3, fx-phone-frame 21, fx-signature 82, fx-gallery-captures 35, landing-and-code-field 22, default-looks 6, card-versions 21, deckbuilder-layout 21: all pass |
| Card tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r121` | 6 passed (8520 + 1106 for the full cards suite before the merge) |
| Engine rule tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' craft` | 43 passed (before the merge) |
| Web tests | vitest on fit, CardFace and fx/aura | 177 passed (836 for the layout, deck-builder and auth tests before the merge) |
| Checks | `spec check`, `patches check`, `catalog check`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` | all clean |
| Typecheck and lint | web, e2e and component typecheck; eslint on the changed files | clean (before the merge; no TypeScript of mine changed since) |
| Classify | `classify --base origin/main --claims`, stage 2 against the base build | micro, visual, no card plays differently, no problems (before the merge) |

- **Classify, how:** `classify` reads two commits and the HEAD of the checkout it was compiled in. I built it in a temporary detached worktree at a throwaway commit of this tree, then removed the worktree.
- **Classify not rerun:** I did not rerun it after the merge. `main`'s four new commits don't touch anything it weighs here, and CI's `rust (classify)` runs it again.

## Decisions the plan did not settle

- **Merge conflict in `apps/web/src/test/tileBoard.ts`: I took `main`'s version whole.** #3442 fixed the same `fx-phone-frame` gap (20 tile auras) by cycling the two Field Spells that still lack an aura of their own. My version filled the backrow with Units instead, which needs 18 aura-less Units, and #3442 had just given more cards auras of their own. So this branch no longer changes that file.
- **`fit.test.tsx` shrinks the box to 46 px, not the plan's 40.** At 40 px the text can't stay above the 9 px floor, so it switches to the long layout and the font stays at 10, and the "refitted smaller" check could never pass.
- **The player note is under `fixes`, not the plan's `changes`.** That is where other fragments put a bug fix.
- **The deal wait stays inside spec 38,** as the plan chose. Putting it in `cy.settled()` would change every spec's timing.

In `.github/workflows/super.yml`, replace the `component` job (line 345) with:

```yaml

    name: e2e component (chrome ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }})
    needs: wasm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: unpack the WASM module
        run: tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/web-build.tgz"
      - name: the fixture board's layout, measured in a browser

      - name: keep the evidence when it fails
